C1.worst_defect: The hero is clear, but the home table's refund cell for your own store reads "No, not on plugin 0.3.0: refund in the Vendure Dashboard. The refund stays Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls". That is admin-API jargon on the marketing page and makes a newcomer think the product is half-built.
C1.where: home.desktop.02 'Live demo or your own store' table, row 'Refund a sale at the till'; home.phone.04

C2.worst_defect: The home table says the demo sends "anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com". A visitor who has never heard of wcpos sees a different brand's domain with no explanation on this page; it is only explained on Connect a till as "a self-hosted PostHog analytics server".
C2.where: home.desktop.02 table row 'Sales reach Vendure, once each, even offline', Live demo column; home.phone.04

C3.worst_defect: The 'Quick start' is about 6,900 px of nine steps. It includes writing two of your own TypeScript migration scripts (src/generate-migration.ts and src/run-migrations.ts) and a collapsed leftover, "If your store already allows vendurepos.vercel.app", which points at an old domain the reader has never seen.
C3.where: quick-start.desktop.01-03 (step 3 and the step 5 disclosure); quick-start.phone.06

C4.worst_defect: The changelog reads as internal notes rather than user-facing release notes. Examples: "GET /tally/v1/info advertises order.create 1–5 (ADR 0005)", "Migration TallyPosV51790900000000 adds the v5 custom fields", and repeated ADR 0004/0005 links. A reader can't tell what changed for them without decoding protocol versions.

C5.worst_defect: Under 'What it does today' only the first two features get bordered cards with buttons. The next eight are a two-column wall of grey body text with no icons or images, so the page below the hero screenshot looks like a docs page rather than a product page.
C5.where: home.desktop.01 bottom to home.desktop.02 top ('Paid, fulfilled, at the till's price' through 'Line and order discounts')

C6.worst_defect: The phone header on home shows only 'Docs' and 'Live demo' beside the logo; Quick start sits behind the chevron. The hero till screenshot is cropped to two product tiles, with the category chip row cut at "Gif" on the right edge.

C7.worst_defect: The share card's till screenshot is cut off at the bottom edge through the first row of product cards, so the price badges are clipped. Otherwise Lighthouse scores 98/100/100/100, the 404 page returns a real 404, and llms.txt, the sitemap and the search API all respond.

overall_worst.defect: Past the hero, the home page speaks to someone already running Vendure. The 'Live demo or your own store' table and 'Before you start' put admin-API refund settlement, an unexplained ph.wcpos.com domain, Node semver ranges and an RXDB_PREMIUM licence token in front of a visitor still deciding whether to try the demo.
overall_worst.where: home.desktop.02 ('Live demo or your own store' table and 'Before you start'); home.phone.04-05
overall_worst.fix: On the home page, cut the refund cell to "Not yet on plugin 0.3.0: refund in the Vendure Dashboard" and the demo cell to "No: the demo store lives in your browser (privacy note)", linking to the details. Move the Node and RXDB_PREMIUM lines into the docs Overview requirements.
